name: APIVerveMeteoriteLandings
summary: Meteorite Landings searches recorded meteor strikes by specimen name and minimum mass.
description:
Meteorite Landings searches recorded meteor strikes by specimen name and minimum mass. Each record includes the official specimen name, meteorite classification, mass in grams, and the recorded fall year.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Meteorite Landings from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
